item.title: PantryLens | Edge-Routed AI Vision PWA
item.author: kourtneylee1611@gmail.com (Kuo-Hsiu (Kourtney) Lee)
item.description: An AI-driven Progressive Web App (PWA) designed to process unstructured visual data and generate real-time recipes. Built to demonstrate secure, low-latency edge computing, the application autonomously parses pantry inventories via image recognition to structure outputs for highly specialized dietary profiles. Dispatched vision tasks to the Gemma 4 model, engineered a real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) pipeline, and utilized Redis for sliding-window IP rate limiting.
